evidence_items.explanation: The earlier human study describes one tutorial task followed by a short experimental session, rather than hundreds of preparatory tasks, and reports 64.2% average public-evaluation accuracy. It also identifies 400 training and 400 evaluation tasks; this is historical comparator evidence, not an experiment on the December o3 system.

unresolved_gaps: The exact o3 training procedure and number of individual demonstration pairs were not disclosed.
There is no matched experiment establishing human preparation needed to reach the same accuracy as the tested o3.
